title: Keep one repetition until it changes you
summary: Naam deepens when one return is kept past mood and vanity. Stay with one-pointed Naam until the walk becomes pure.
takeaway: Stay with one-pointed Naam until the walk becomes pure.
lifeApplication: When novelty calls, keep the repetition one round longer and let sangat, Naam, and peace train the walk.
